runtime_store: Existing authorized source/sequence store; otherwise structured append-only records in the existing private Reporting Journal. No public live histories or new database.

datasets.cadence: Top-free US/CA/GB each existing Radar slot when source version changes. Top-paid US at 08:00, CA at 11:00, GB at 15:00, or a due case.
datasets.probe_2026_09_24: Top-free US/CA/GB ordered entries and timestamps readable; US top-paid feed header readable. CA/GB paid and complete 100-row captures not verified.
datasets.limits: Feed order is ordinal popularity, not download volume, active use or revenue. Paid rank is not grossing rank. Preserve actual captured depth.

datasets.origin: Google Play primary where explicit chart data is readable; AppBrain fallback is a separate provider
datasets.cadence: US free applications source-version check each run; CA at 11:00 and GB at 15:00 where country chart access is verified. Daily provider refresh is not three daily observations.
datasets.probe_2026_09_24: AppBrain US rank rows readable with September 23 source date; Play storefront readable but not validated as a complete ranking feed. CA/GB not verified.
datasets.limits: Capture linked provider/app ID, country and category. Do not conflate overall/apps-only/games. Provider labels require identity verification before cross-platform matching. No paid CSV or API access authorized.

datasets.cadence: Existing unseeded behaviour/capability and non-AI search pass; use available authorized web search without pretending its engine is Google.
datasets.limits: Search results discover original evidence, not aggregate search demand. Result counts, autocomplete and personal search history are not demand metrics.

datasets.cadence: US each run; CA morning and GB afternoon; inspect relevant product/category/use-case candidates rather than forcing finance stories from every trend.
datasets.probe_2026_09_24: US UI rows readable, first page only; RSS retrieval failed. CA/GB not verified.
datasets.limits: Retain selected region/window/sort, pagination and source buckets such as 50K+ as bounds, not exact counts. Relative start labels are not precise timestamps. Shared coverage can drive several metrics together.

datasets.cadence: Daily selected category/related-rising-query discovery when accessible; candidate-specific product/use-case/buy/setup/cancel comparisons at named evidence dates.
datasets.probe_2026_09_24: Documentation verified; quantitative Explore/export access and API authorization not verified.
datasets.limits: Sampled normalized indices; preserve query/topic, country, category, search type, period, aggregation and normalization group. Do not splice independently normalized requests. Do not treat <1 or missing as zero. API alpha is not assumed enabled.

datasets.cadence: Bounded follow-through when chart/search evidence merits investigation; recheck dated cases after meaningful app updates.
datasets.limits: Read actual recent text and release notes, not only lifetime stars. Record sample count, selection, country/language, version/date and origin. Separate use, payment, substitution, reliability and cancellation. No general competitor-review access is inferred from developer APIs.

datasets.cadence: One rotating non-AI product category daily and due product cases; reuse existing non-AI pass.
datasets.probe_2026_09_24: US Movers & Shakers retrieval failed; no retail baseline established.
datasets.limits: Capture ASIN/variant, country, category, rank type, seller, price/coupon and availability separately. Movers & Shakers rank movement is not sales growth. Do not bypass access controls.

datasets.cadence: Rotating non-AI daily check when usable data is available; retry established access gaps at most weekly unless authorization/access changes.
datasets.probe_2026_09_24: Public shell returned no usable metrics. Business help readable; account-specific access not connected or authorized here.
datasets.limits: Record region, search/save/shopping metric, observation versus prediction, period and scaling. Saving is not buying. Do not invent values or silently replace a series with a forecast report.

datasets.cadence: Resolve relevant public manufacturer/retailer pages from new signals and revisit at a named interval.
datasets.limits: Exact SKU, variant, seller, location and collection time required for comparisons. Preserve promotions, supply shortages and changed page definitions. No claimed sell-through from availability alone.

on_demand_only: GitHub and Hugging Face technical activity
review_rule: Numeric anomalies are research pointers, not scores or automatic trades. First observations can still surface under the qualitative Camillo EARLY gate. No population-level adoption claim without appropriate evidence.
identity_rule: Stable source IDs first; names, developer labels and ticker mappings are separately verified. Same brand across countries does not prove the same app or contract. Preserve Core/Camillo case and exact instrument scope.
